hero_subtitle: Explore how Burnley Borough Council spends public money. All data comes from publicly available council documents.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.

publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £355.2M across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £217.7M. Procurement-committed (POs in the contracts feed) = £137.5M — ~77% pair with a matching spend record within 90 days, so paid + committed double-counts those pairs. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

procurement_committed.note: POs raised in the contracts feed. High pairing rate with matching spend records (same invoice seen twice). Excluded from duplicate/split forensic analyses.
